description.value:
Level 5 Child feature.

  • Gain proficiency with one tool set or language of your choice. Retained on graduation.
  • Gain proficiency with one weapon or shield from your Knack class's list. Lost on graduation. (Granted via your Knack item.)
  • Roll 2d<Knack hit die> and gain that many gold pieces.
  • Gain one item the character is proficient with (compendium prompt).

advTsToolLang000.title: Trade Skill (Tool / Language)
advTsToolLang000.hint: Choose one tool proficiency or one language. Retained on graduation.
